name: General Lektor
about: General Lektor is a Veridian general trusted by all sides. The book calls him middle-aged and mentions a military-style shirt; the rest of this look is invented and contributors are welcome to replace it.

facts.quote: A middle-aged man entered the room.
a shirt that seemed almost perfectly designed to strike the balance of looking like traditional Veridian military attire while being comfortable for everyday wear
facts.fact: Wears a comfortable shirt styled like traditional Veridian military attire.

facts.quote: "Alright, does everyone know their tasks?", Lektor asked loudly.

descriptor: a middle-aged man of about fifty, tall and solidly built, light olive skin, short iron-grey hair in a crew cut, a square clean-shaven jaw and an upright bearing, wearing a structured khaki-brown military-style tunic shirt with a diagonal side closure, sculpted shoulder plates and a stiff standing collar, a dark brown belt-harness across the chest, dark brown segmented trousers and polished seamless brown boots
